description: Na₃V(SO)₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbca space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five S and one O atom. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.84-3.07 Å. The Na-O bond length is 2.36 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to one S and three O atoms to form distorted NaSO₃ trigonal pyramids that share corners with four equivalent VS₂O₂ tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent NaSO₃ trigonal pyramids. The Na-S bond length is 2.79 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.36 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four S and two O atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.92-3.26 Å. There is one shorter (2.37 Å) and one longer (2.49 Å) Na-O bond length. V is bonded to two S and two O atoms to form distorted VS₂O₂ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaSO₃ trigonal pyramids. There is one shorter (2.21 Å) and one longer (2.23 Å) V-S bond length. There is one shorter (1.71 Å) and one longer (1.72 Å) V-O bond length. There are two inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one V atom. In the second S site, S is bonded to five Na and one V atom to form distorted SNa₅V octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SNa₅V octahedra, corners with six ONa₃V tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent SNa₅V octahedra, and edges with three ONa₃V tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 3°. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three Na and one V atom to form distorted ONa₃V tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent SNa₅V octahedra, corners with six ONa₃V tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent SNa₅V octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 68-86°. In the second O site, O is bonded to three Na and one V atom to form ONa₃V tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent SNa₅V octahedra, corners with four equivalent ONa₃V tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one SNa₅V octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 21-73°.
